name: PayrollSampleRoles
description: Adds three sample roles for payroll: Payroll administrator (everything), Payroll clerk (prepares pay runs and keeps pay profiles, never approves) and Payroll approver (approves pay runs). Each covers every employer; for a clerk of one employer, give a role the per-employer permissions, such as Prepare pay runs for an employer, instead.
author: CrestApps

Roles.Name: Payroll administrator
Roles.Description: Sets up and runs payroll for every employer.

Roles.Name: Payroll clerk
Roles.Description: Keeps pay profiles and prepares pay runs. Never approves them.
